title: Will Howard: Unbelievable opportunity to learn from Aaron Rodgers

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Will Howard: Unbelievable opportunity to learn from Aaron Rodgers
sources.description: Will Howard's chances of starting games at quarterback for the Steelers this season took a hit with Aaron Rodgers's return to Pittsburgh this week, but the 2025 sixth-round pick wasn't lamenting the turn of events on Wednesday.
